                  The archive

                  Every finished task is a box. Each week fills a shelf; this is every shelf so far. Tap a week to read its labels.

                  The journal

                  One line a day, kept in the journal on the archive desk. Every line so far, newest first.

                  Time capsules

                  Sealed until their day. The tin on the shelf glows when one is ready.

                        AI or not, every time

                        Wherever AI could help (Ask, Split, Talk, new lines) there are two buttons. The plain one runs on Mite's own lines, on this device. The dashed ✦ one asks Claude, shows roughly what it costs, and files what it writes into the lines below, so the offline library keeps growing and you need AI less over time.

                        Lines

                        Every pool is one entry per line. Add as many as you like; your pet picks lines that fit the moment and avoids repeating itself.

                          New from Mite

                          Lines Mite wrote with AI help and filed into the right pools. They work offline from now on. Remove any that don't sound right.

                            Conditions go in square brackets at the start: [tue h8-10] Training soon. Mite only says the line when all of them fit.
                            Days mon…sun, workday offday office home; times morning afternoon evening night h9-12; state busy (6+ open) open0 done0 doneSome streak3 lvl5 messy (6+ bits of mess); seasons autumn winter spring summer; moon fullmoon newmoon waxing waning; halloween (20–31 Oct); strange (Strangeness on); anomalies door phone eyes (omen pool); rare makes a line four times less likely.
                            Variables: {you} {pet} {open} {oldest} {oldestAge} {smallest} {doneToday} {week} {total} {streak} {level} {favHour} {daysTogether} {doneBy} {bed} {pats} {moon} {clearance} {incidents} {n} (random number), plus {task} {age} {item} {away} {awayTime} where the pool provides them. A line whose variable is unknown at that moment is skipped.

                            Personality (only used when AI help is on)

                            AI usage

                            Every AI call is logged here. Counts are estimates from text length (about 3.6 characters per token); the real number is somewhat higher because the platform adds its own framing to each call.

                            Backup

                            Keep a copy somewhere safe, or use it to move to another device: send the file to yourself (mail, a chat, a cloud drive), save it, or copy it.
